model.title: 21st Century Dyslexia Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Bill Cassidy (R-LA)

summary.text: The bill would separate dyslexia from the broader category of learning disabilities in federal education law and create its own definition focused on unexpected reading difficulties caused by challenges processing sounds in language. It also aims to ensure that students from low-income families, economically disadvantaged backgrounds, and those with limited English proficiency have equal access to dyslexia-related services and accommodations in schools.
